verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only a Next.js integration guide and general SDKs (TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go) plus a community mention of 'automatic schema migrations' with Turso itself, but no documented guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django, or Rails are present in the evidence pack. missing for 10: dedicated Prisma guide, dedicated Drizzle guide, dedicated Django guide, dedicated Rails guide, independent corroboration of ORM compatibility.
